title: Enterprise Omnichannel AI Customer Support Agent (RAG Platform)
shortDescription: 24/7 intelligent customer support agent powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), syncing knowledge from corporate documents and website portals with seamless Web Widget, Zalo, and Messenger integrations.

overview.summary: An omnichannel AI customer care platform designed to resolve up to 80% of repetitive customer inquiries autonomously, referencing verified company policy documents with zero hallucinations.
overview.background: Small-and-medium enterprises suffer from overwhelmed support queues during surge hours. Night-shift staffing is expensive, while legacy rule-based chatbots fail to understand conversational nuances.

challenge.title: Zero-Hallucination Precision & Token Cost Optimization
challenge.problem: Handling natural, colloquial customer queries containing abbreviations and typos while locating the exact clause across hundreds of document pages within 1.5 seconds.
bottlenecks: Escalating LLM token usage costs when feeding raw document excerpts into every prompt.
Model hallucination fabricating invalid promotional policies outside allowed boundaries.
High query-to-answer latency without concurrent vector retrieval and streaming synthesis.

solution.title: Hybrid RAG Pipeline with Semantic Caching & PostgreSQL pgvector
solution.approach: Integrated vector storage natively within PostgreSQL via `pgvector`, combining BM25 keyword matching with dense embeddings and Redis-backed semantic caching.
keyInnovations: Hierarchical Chunking preserving tabular layout and structured product attribute matrices.
Strict Guardrail filters preventing prompt injection exploits and off-policy disclosures.
Semantic Caching eliminating up to 55% of costly LLM inference calls for frequent inquiries.

architecture.overview: High-throughput asynchronous RAG architecture orchestrated with Docker and Next.js.

layers.tech: Next.js Web Widget, Zalo OA Webhooks, Facebook Messenger API
layers.detail: Lightweight embeddable chat widget integrated with a single line of JavaScript code.
Classifies customer intent, routes domain queries through RAG, or triggers human agent handoff.
Houses 1536-dimensional embeddings with HNSW indexing for sub-10ms nearest neighbor queries.
Self-service document upload portal (PDF, Word, FAQ URLs) with live conversation analytics.

features.title: Automated Document Ingestion & Vectorization
features.description: Upload product catalogues or paste website URLs to ingest and build searchable knowledge vectors in under 2 minutes.
technicalHighlights: Advanced tabular text extraction from complex multi-page PDF documents.
Instant document updates with zero model fine-tuning required.

features.title: Seamless Human Handover with AI Summaries
features.description: Escalates frustrated customers or complex complaints to live support representatives with a 3-line AI briefing.
technicalHighlights: Real-time sentiment scoring flagging escalation signals.
Automated conversational context summarization saving minutes of onboarding time.

visuals.title: Hybrid Search RAG Architecture Flow
visuals.description: Workflow from customer query through Guardrails, pgvector search, and synthesized response.

visuals.title: Knowledge Base Management Console
visuals.description: Administrative UI for uploading manuals, testing prompts, and auditing conversations.

takeaways: Leveraging pgvector within PostgreSQL eliminates the operational complexity of managing standalone vector database clusters.
Hierarchical document chunking combined with strict guardrails is essential for production-grade zero-hallucination support agents.
